messages:
marta: Heads-up — packaging for the VPC/offline bundle is ready for handoff. Targeting transfer window tomorrow 03:00-04:00 UTC. Need signoff on checksum + rollback criteria.
packaging-bot: Build artifacts: installer-v2.8.1.tar.gz, imageset-2026-03-20.tar.zst. Signed and uploaded to staging S3 replica. Manifests: manifest-v2.json + manifest-v2.sig.
packaging-bot: Checksums (sha256):
```
installer-v2.8.1.tar.gz  a3f9c2e8b6d4f1e9c4d2a0b1f9e7d5c3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4d3e2f1a0b9c8d7
imageset-2026-03-20.tar.zst  f1e2d3c4b5a697887766554433221100ffeeddccbbaa99887766554433221100
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled transfer job created: transfer-9843. Window: 2141673600-2141677200 UTC. Canary target: customer-vpc-canary-1 (1 node). Auto-rollback: enabled with threshold 5m error rate > 3% or latency p95 increase > 2x.
alex: @marta quick q — which image tag are we pinning for the canary? we need exact tag to prevent drift.
marta: pin=redwood/inference:v2.8.1-20260320. Also adding a fallback tag redwood/inference:v2.8.0 for immediate fallback if upload fails.
nate: Can we tighten rollback rules? 3% error over 3m might be noisy. Propose: abort if 3 consecutive 1m buckets exceed 4% OR if any 1m bucket > 8%. Also require manual ack from SRE if service-level pager fires.
sre-ops: prefer manual ack for stateful onprem cutovers. automated rollback okay for obvious failures (image mismatch, unzip errors). For perf regressions we want automatic pause + notify and then manual decision.
marta: agreed. Update: automatic rollback on artifact verification failure, unpack failure, or healthcheck failing to reach 1/1 for 2m. For perf we will pause canary and notify on-call.
packaging-bot: Transfer checklist posted:
- artifacts uploaded to staging S3 (done)
- signed manifests (done)
- cosign signatures validated (done)
- shrinkwrap tags created (done)
- offline bundle md5/sha256 attached (done)
- OCI image tarball verified (done)
- delivery note / runbook attached to PR 4521 (done)

packaging-bot: Verification command examples:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-staging/offline/imageset-2026-03-20.tar.zst ./ 
sha256sum imageset-2026-03-20.tar.zst
cosign verify-blob --signature manifest-v2.sig manifest-v2.json
```
kelsey: Link to release notes / runbook? need to include upgrade steps for customers doing manual import. Also add troubleshooting section for KMS/HSM timeouts.
marta: runbook link: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/offline-delivery/4521-2026-03-20. Adding KMS note now.
alex: Also call out required disk space for unpack: 120GB free on the target host. Add a preflight script?
packaging-bot: Preflight script attached in PR 4521: `preflight.sh` checks disk, uname, kernel modules, iptables rules, and available GPUs (if applicable).
deploy-bot: Canary start initiated at 2141673600. Notifying customer ops and on-call. I will post progress updates here.
marta: @deploy-bot ensure transfer uses multipart resume and verifies sha256 after transfer. Also set bandwidth cap to 200Mbps for offsite transfers.
deploy-bot: Transfer started. Part uploads in-progress.
packaging-bot: Note: we observed a minor timestamp drift on one artifact (manifest timestamp off by 2s). This doesn't affect signature verification but flagging for records.
alex: Received: can we tag the imageset with digest in the release notes rather than mutable tag? helps customers.
marta: yes — include digest: sha256:f1e2d3c4b5a69788... (full digest in PR).
nate: If transfer fails mid-window, plan is: 1) attempt resume twice, 2) if still failing, abort and push rollback marker to manifest (v2.8.1-ABORT) and notify customers and sales. Confirm?
sre-ops: Confirm. Also open incident (sev3) if resume fails twice.
packaging-bot: Transfer completed. Post-transfer verification passed.
deploy-bot: Canary health: 60s checks passing, p95 latency baseline within +10%. No errors. Continuing rollout to canary set 2.
marta: Good progress. Keep runbook open and tag on-call for any anomalies.
kelsey: drafting release-notes entry now, will append here.
kelsey: RN draft: "Private/VPC: v2.8.1 offline bundle — improved runtime kv-cache behavior, smaller imageset, and packaging fixes for airgapped installs. See runbook for manual import steps."
packaging-bot: Post-deploy cleanup tasks queued (PR 4523): revoke temporary staging creds, rotate delivery keys, and archive staging artifacts after 7 days.
alex: thumbs-up. Thanks all.
marta: Final: marking thread resolved when prod cutover complete. If anything unexpected during the full rollout, we'll revert to v2.8.0 and open postmortem. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Deployment complete across target fleet. Canary -> full rollout succeeded. Closing transfer job transfer-9843.
